u0: Ongoing task phase: you are not in the immediate post-fall response and have not yet reached the exit successfully. Keep the box in hand while navigating to the bottom-right exit; if the box is not currently held, reacquire it before exiting. Reaching the exit while holding the box enters terminal success u2 and earns the full reward, while arriving without it fails. If the box falls, this state transitions to u1.
u1: Immediate post-fall phase: the box has just slipped from your hands and is not currently held. Make your very next action a pickup of the fallen box, which in the standard setup leaves you facing its landing cell; a successful pickup returns to u0 and earns the recovery bonus. Any other action also returns to u0 but forfeits that bonus, leaving you to recover the box before trying to exit.
u2: Terminal success: you reached the exit while holding the box. The task is complete and the full exit reward has been earned; no further objective remains.
